parsed.faithful: HELMINTHOLITHUS, in natural history, a name given by Linnaeus to petrified bodies resembling worms. Of these he reckons four genera. 1. Petrified lithophyta, found in the mountains of Sweden. 2. Petrified shells. 3. Petrified zoophytes. 4. Petrified reptiles.
